Triage (2026-09-20T15:45Z): lands in `domain:cli` · `priority:p2` · type `Bug`.

**Lane `domain:cli`.** `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts` — the 域车道 table's `domain:cli` row.

**Grade `p2`.** 北极星「优先级」4: 「写给 AI 的文档与 skills 说错一句,等于产品缺陷」. The module header gives a claim ADR-0048 **retired** as the live justification for the naming lints — 「a bare-name collision silently overwrites across packages」 — and a module header is the first thing any reader, human or model, takes as the file's position. Under `references/lanes/spec.md`'s 第二刀 (「它误导了 AI 吗」) this one does: someone reasoning about why the lint exists reasons from a mechanism that no longer happens. 误导 ⇒ `P2`, ⛔ not the 关 not planned disposition a non-misleading prose nit takes.

Type `Bug`: a docblock stating a behaviour the platform does not have.

## ⭐ The correction is already in the file, 900 lines down

`:929` declines that exact sentence **by name**: 「⚠️ The REASON is authoring hygiene, and ⛔ deliberately not *"one silently overwrites the other at registration"*. That sentence is this module's older framing and ADR-0048 retired it.」

⇒ this is ⛔ not a research task and there is ⛔ nothing to adjudicate: one file holds both the retired claim and its retraction, and the retraction never reached the top. The deliverable is to carry `:929`'s wording up to the header. ⚠️ ⛔ Do not delete the header's justification and leave the lints unexplained — 「authoring hygiene」 IS the reason, and the header should say so.

⭐ Recorded because it is the second card this round of exactly this shape (objectui#10070 is the other): **a correction that landed on one copy and never reached the sibling copy**. Whoever fixes this one should say on the card whether the same retired sentence survives anywhere else — objectstack-ai/objectstack#19358 is already one more instance of the same ADR-0048 claim, in a published skill.

⚠️ The finding arrived from a read-only prose sweep the filing seat commissioned **after the docs-drift check disclaimed coverage**. ⇒ ⛔ do not expect a gate to have caught this or to catch the next one; that gap is its own question and ⛔ not this card's.

Size/model suggestion: S.

## The job — and ⭐ the correction is already in the file

The module header states the **retired** ADR-0048 claim as the live justification:

> **Lint**: namespace-prefix naming (doc uniqueness is logical — the metadata registry key carries no package coordinate, so a **bare-name collision silently overwrites across packages**)

⭐ **Line 929 of the same file declines that exact sentence, by name**, in wording that landed via #19248:

> ⚠️ The REASON is authoring hygiene, and ⛔ deliberately not *"one silently overwrites the other at registration"*. That sentence is this module's older framing and ADR-0048 retired it.

⇒ the wording does **not** have to be re-derived — it exists, 900 lines down. The header near-quotes ADR-0048 **§1.1**, a *context* heading that the ADR's own §3.1 / §3.3 / §3.4 then overturned. ⚠️ Reading the ADR from the top and stopping early reproduces exactly this error.

## ⚠️ The part that makes this a judgement, not a copy-paste

⛔ **The header sentence justifies `docs/namespace-prefix` as well, not only `docs/duplicate-name`.** The line-929 correction was written about `duplicate-name`. So carrying it up verbatim would silently re-state a justification for a **second** rule that nobody has examined.

⇒ **Read what `docs/namespace-prefix` actually rests on** and say so explicitly in your report. If the corrected reason covers both, say why. If it does not, the header must distinguish them rather than smuggle one under the other — ⭐ which is the same failure this card is about, one level up.

⛔ Do **not** change either rule's behaviour, message, or severity. This is a docblock correction.

## ⛔ What this round must not become

⛔ Do not sweep the file for other stale justifications and fix them. If you find one, report it — ⭐ #19248's round found this very card that way, by reporting rather than fixing.

⚠️ `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` carries the **same** retired claim and is filed as **#19358**, Tier H, ⛔ not this lane's and ⛔ not this round's.

## Fences

⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/`. Changeset: derive from the repo's gates — ⚠️ #19248 measured that a comment-only diff in `@objectstack/cli` **does** reach the published tarball (`files[]` includes `dist`, built with plain `tsc`, no `removeComments`), so ⛔ do not assume `skip-changeset`; re-measure it. If required, `patch` — ⛔ never `major`. Commit trailers **model-free**. English. Draft PR, `Fixes #19359`.

⚠️ If any part of this order is imprecise or contradicts what you measure, **say so and stop rather than silently matching it**.

⚠️ A third probe, `silently overwrites across`, read **1/1**. Chased rather than explained away: it survives **exactly once, inside the quotation that declines it** —

> *"…but ⛔ NOT because "a bare-name collision silently overwrites across packages": that sentence is ADR-0048 §1.1 context, overturned by the same ADR's §3.3/§3.4"*

⇒ ⭐ a *wrong* probe, ⛔ not a failed one: **a correction that names the sentence it retires necessarily contains that sentence.** The probe that straddles the change is the **premise**, and it reads cleanly. Second time this shift a 1/1 reading turned out to be a badly-chosen probe rather than a bad landing — ⛔ and both times the answer came from looking, not from assuming.

### ⭐ The card was wrong in my favour

**#19359 as I filed it says the header states a retired CONCLUSION.** The round showed the **premise was never true of the write path at all** — so the inference never held, even before §3.4 retired the throw.

Verified by this seat on `origin/main`:

- `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:3452` — `storageKey = packageId ? withDisc(\`${packageId}:${baseName}\`) : bareKey`, with the `Overwriting` log firing only on `collection.has(storageKey)` ⇒ **the same composite key, i.e. the same package**;
- `packages/metadata-core/src/types.ts:84` — `refKey` returns `` `${org}/${type}/${name}` `` with **no** package coordinate.

⇒ ⭐ the premise is **true of the cache key and false of the key an overwrite would happen on**, which is exactly why it read so convincingly. The real residual is a **context-free first-match read**, ⛔ not an overwrite.

### The judgement the round had to make

⛔ Carrying line 929's correction up verbatim would have been wrong: it was written about `docs/duplicate-name`, while the header sentence also justifies `docs/namespace-prefix` and `docs/namespace-required`.

⇒ the header now **distinguishes** them: `duplicate-name` is attributed by **pointing at** `lintDocNamesAcrossOwners` rather than copying it — ⭐ *a second copy is how the first went stale* — and the namespace rules are attributed to what they actually rest on, the flat link namespace of ADR-0046 §3.1/§3.3.

### The declared fence breach — **accepted**

The `lintDocNamesAcrossOwners` docblock ended with *"it is still live in this file's HEADER docblock"*, which the header edit **makes false**. ⛔ That is not the pre-existing staleness my order fenced out; it is a claim **this PR itself falsifies**.

⇒ ⭐ **a fence never licenses leaving behind a falsehood your own diff created.** Reverting it would have shipped a self-contradicting file in the interim — exactly #19359's failure mode.

### Root cause filed as **#19408**

`docs/adr/0046-package-docs-as-metadata.md:138-145` still carries the **entire inference verbatim, premise included**, with its two ADR-0048 mentions at lines 335 and 525 — ⛔ neither annotating that passage — and a status line still reading `Proposed`. That sentence has already regenerated into **two** downstream copies (this card, and #19358 in the Tier H skill catalog).

⛔ #19408 does **not** assert the ADR must be edited; ADRs are dated records and that is a governance call.

### Changeset — re-measured, ⛔ not inherited

`patch`, not `skip-changeset`: `removeComments` greps to zero, `npm pack --dry-run` lists `dist/utils/collect-docs.js`, and in `dist` the retired phrase occurs **exactly once — inside the quotation that declines it**, while `dist/**/*.d.ts` carries 0.
